beforeYouConnect: You need to be an admin of your Linear workspace: only an admin can add the webhook you will paste Frink's address into.

actions.label: Find Linear issues
actions.description: Lists issues in your workspace, filtered by team, state, assignee or text.

actions.label: Get a Linear issue
actions.description: Reads one issue by ID, with its description, state, assignee and attachments.

actions.label: Create or update a Linear issue
actions.description: Creates a new issue, or updates the issue whose ID you give.

actions.label: List comments on a Linear issue
actions.description: Lists the comments on an issue, project or document.

actions.label: Comment on a Linear issue
actions.description: Adds a comment to an issue, project or document.

actions.label: List Linear projects
actions.description: Lists the projects in your workspace.
